basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old dog owner from Wellington, New Zealand, who recently joined Reddit to find tips and share frustrations about pet ownership. I have a mixed-breed puppy who's a handful, especially in the rainy season. Besides that, I'm a huge Marvel fan, enjoy off-roading in my 4WD, and have a peculiar interest in niche communities like 'consentacles'. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work as a barista. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner, who shares my interest in Marvel movies but is more into fashion, hence my lurking in 'TheNorthFace'.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is mostly self-taught and comes from practical experiences. I grew up with dogs and have always been a hands-on learner. My interest in Marvel started as a kid and has grown over the years through comics and movies. I picked up off-roading from my dad, who used to take me on weekend adventures.
